OWAI.Adjudication.Title: AI attack adjudication
OWAI.Settings.TurnPacing.Name: AI turn pacing (ms)
OWAI.Settings.TurnPacing.Hint: Pause between AI steps and before the turn advances so automated turns stay watchable. 0 disables the delay.
OWAI.Settings.AiDifficulty.Name: AI difficulty
OWAI.Settings.AiDifficulty.Hint: Tactical depth of AI planning. Easy bots ignore the threat map and sometimes pick suboptimal moves; hard bots additionally run the counter-attack lookahead.
OWAI.Settings.PreviewTimeout.Name: AI preview timeout (seconds)
OWAI.Settings.PreviewTimeout.Hint: Seconds a GM plan preview may stay undecided before the plan is auto-cancelled. 0 disables the timeout.
OWAI.Settings.DamageWaitTimeout.Name: Damage adjudication wait (seconds)
OWAI.Settings.DamageWaitTimeout.Hint: Seconds a landed bot attack waits for the GM to roll and apply the damage card before the turn advances. 0 waits indefinitely; a manual turn advance always releases the wait.
OWAI.Settings.DamageWaitAutoAdvance.Name: Advance after damage adjudication
OWAI.Settings.DamageWaitAutoAdvance.Hint: On: the turn advances itself once the GM's damage card is applied. Off: a settled damage wait hands the turn back to manual GM control — apply damage and advance at your own pace.
OWAI.Settings.CenterOnBot.Name: Center view on acting bot
OWAI.Settings.CenterOnBot.Hint: Pans the GM canvas to the bot when its turn starts so automated and previewed turns stay watchable without hunting the token.
OWAI.Preview.Title: AI plan preview
OWAI.Preview.Target.Label: Target
OWAI.Preview.Action.Label: Action
OWAI.Preview.Route.Label: Route
OWAI.Preview.Route.Empty: No movement — the NPC stays in place.
OWAI.Preview.Projected.Label: Projected resource cost

OWAI.Notifications.PreviewCancelled: Only War AI: plan for {name} cancelled ({reason}). The turn stays under manual GM control.
OWAI.Notifications.PreviewTimeout: Only War AI: plan preview for {name} timed out and was cancelled. The turn stays under manual GM control.
OWAI.Notifications.ReplanFailed: Only War AI: replan for {name} failed ({reason}).
OWAI.Notifications.DamageWaiting: Only War AI: {name} is holding the turn — apply the damage card hits or advance the turn manually to continue.
OWAI.Notifications.DamageSettled: Only War AI: damage applied — the turn stays under manual GM control. Advance it when ready.
OWAI.Settings.MasterEnabled.Name: Enable Only War AI
OWAI.Settings.MasterEnabled.Hint: Master switch for the whole module. Off: no AI turns are claimed or executed, the GM preview never opens and injected UI is hidden. Individual NPC flags are kept for when it is turned back on.
OWAI.Settings.ThreatMapOverlay.Name: Threat map debug overlay
OWAI.Settings.ThreatMapOverlay.Hint: Draw the AI threat-map heat cells on the scene canvas. GM-only debug visualization — players never see it. Hotkey: Alt+M.
OWAI.Settings.AttackAdjudication.Name: Attack adjudication
OWAI.Settings.AttackAdjudication.Hint: Auto: the system roll API resolves AI attacks. GM confirm: before every attack/test step a GM chat card offers to execute it, roll it manually, substitute a skill test or take the turn back. Preview mode always asks the GM once for the whole plan.
OWAI.Settings.LayerCommitment.Name: Behaviour layer: commitment (L1)
OWAI.Settings.LayerCommitment.Hint: A still-valid multi-turn plan executes its next step instead of scoring from scratch. The record persists on the combatant (TTL, expectedState, invalidation on drift/dead target/morale/GM intervention); without a valid record planning is unchanged.
OWAI.Settings.LayerMorale.Name: Behaviour layer: morale (L2)
OWAI.Settings.LayerMorale.Hint: The fireteam posture (confident/pressured/desperate) counted from members, losses, pinned fighters, enemies and space control — hysteresis 2 rounds, leader loss forces the transition. Desperate teams regroup toward cover, confident ones push wider assaults; fanatics ignore desperate, cowards crack early. Off = neutral baseline everywhere.
OWAI.Settings.LayerPersonality.Name: Behaviour layer: personality (L3)
OWAI.Settings.LayerPersonality.Hint: Applies per-bot trait weight deltas (bounded to ±30% of the base weight) and the seeded score jitter. Off = fully deterministic base scoring.
OWAI.Settings.LayerLookahead.Name: Behaviour layer: lookahead (L4)
OWAI.Settings.LayerLookahead.Hint: Allows the 2-ply counter-damage re-scoring pass on hard difficulty. Off = base utility only, even on hard.
OWAI.Settings.ManualOverrideGrace.Name: Manual GM moves are absolute
OWAI.Settings.ManualOverrideGrace.Hint: On: a manual token move never cancels a committed plan and never marks the bot gm-controlled — the plan continues from the new position. Off (default): an unexplained move is gm-intervention, the plan is cancelled and the bot replans on its turn.
OWAI.Settings.AiBarks.Name: AI chat barks
OWAI.Settings.AiBarks.Hint: Short chat phrases telegraphing AI intent: emitted when a fireteam's morale tier changes and when a bot commits to a multi-turn plan. Whispered to the GM by default.
OWAI.Settings.BarksToPlayers.Name: Barks visible to players
OWAI.Settings.BarksToPlayers.Hint: Off (default): AI barks are whispered to the GM only. On: the whole table sees the AI's intent telegraphing.
OWAI.Settings.MoraleDesperateRatio.Name: Desperate when outnumbered
OWAI.Settings.MoraleDesperateRatio.Hint: The enemy-headcount ratio that alone proposes the desperate morale tier: enemies >= members x ratio. Default 2 - a 2:1 deficit is the squad's normal war; parity and small disadvantages stay pressured.

OWAI.Preview.Team.Scope: Projected assignments. Confirmation only applies to the current NPC.

OWAI.Bark.Morale.pressured: Fireteam {team} holds the line under pressure.
OWAI.Bark.Morale.desperate: Fireteam {team} is wavering — fall back to cover!
OWAI.Keybinding.ThreatMapOverlay.Name: Toggle AI threat map overlay
OWAI.Keybinding.ThreatMapOverlay.Hint: Toggle the GM-only threat-map debug overlay on the current scene.
OWAI.Settings.TraceVerbose.Name: AI reason trace verbosity
OWAI.Settings.TraceVerbose.Hint: How the "How it decided" trace renders: compact collapses every layer to its verdict line (grouped vetoes, merged scoring), full shows every recorded reason record.
OWAI.Settings.CaptureContext.Name: AI replay capture
OWAI.Settings.CaptureContext.Hint: Keep a bounded journal (8 entries) of sanitized planContext+snapshot captures on the combatant 'captureJournal' flag. Each entry is a ready-made unit fixture: replay planTurn offline and get the identical plan and trace.
